title: Schema and validation policy for DSH Flow generation contracts
description: Cross-cutting policy applied to all schemas in this directory. Version 1.

schema_version.description: All contract documents declare their schema version as an integer. Validators reject documents whose schema_version exceeds the highest version they support.

unknown_field_policy.description: All schemas set additionalProperties: false. A document with unknown fields is rejected without partial processing. This prevents silent data loss when a newer producer emits fields an older consumer cannot handle.

ownership_model.description: Every artifact file in a generation run has exactly one owner (Creator or Host). Owner is declared in the artifact's schema via the x-owner extension. Creator-owned artifacts are immutable after generation; Host-owned artifacts are immutable after acceptance.

x-policy-rules.versioning: Integer schema_version starting at 1. Bump on incompatible change. Validators reject unknown versions.
x-policy-rules.unknown_fields: additionalProperties: false everywhere. Unknown fields cause fail-closed rejection.
x-policy-rules.ownership: x-owner on each schema root declares creator or host. Validator checks this before allowing writes.
x-policy-rules.immutability: Creator artifacts under generated/ are immutable during accept. Host artifacts are immutable after ACTIVE.
x-policy-rules.fail_closed: Every validation failure rejects the entire document. No partial writes, no partial acceptance.
x-policy-rules.no_secrets: No schema allows credential, token, or secret fields. Routing digests only.
x-policy-rules.no_local_paths: Paths are relative to run root. No absolute filesystem paths in documents.
x-policy-rules.append_only: Event stores (decisions, metrics, budget) use append-only with digest chains.
x-policy-rules.transactional_activation: Modes and skills activate as a unit; never individually.
